# Journalism Dataviz v1.0.25

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on data visualization.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [getDataDW](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/getDataDW.md): getDataDW function
- [getInfoDW](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/getInfoDW.md): getInfoDW function
- [logBarChart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/logBarChart.md): logBarChart function
- [logDotChart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/logDotChart.md): logDotChart function
- [logLineChart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/logLineChart.md): logLineChart function
- [publishChartDW](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/publishChartDW.md): publishChartDW function
- [rewind](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/rewind.md): rewind function
- [saveChart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/saveChart.md): saveChart function
- [updateAnnotationsDW](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/updateAnnotationsDW.md): updateAnnotationsDW function
- [updateDataDW](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/updateDataDW.md): updateDataDW function
- [updateInfoDW](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/updateInfoDW.md): updateInfoDW function
- [updateNotesDW](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-dataviz/v1.0.25/docs/functions/updateNotesDW.md): updateNotesDW function
